heroHeadline: Government and drivers' confederation open Decree 5716 talks in La Paz with no deal; Santa Cruz transport threatens 48-hour strike from Oct 5
heroSubtitle: After the Sept. 29 La Paz dialogue between ministers and the Confederación Sindical de Choferes de Bolivia ended in recess without agreement, the government ruled out reversing Decree 5716's diesel-subsidy removal and proposed sectoral tables and departmental cost studies. Santa Cruz transport, meeting in assembly, set a 48-hour strike for Oct. 5-6 unless the decree is abrogated.
